decks.notes: The main concept of this deck is to establish board presence and disrupt opponents' strategies with efficient and powerful spells. By utilizing cards like Dragon's Rage Channeler, Murktide Regent, and Lightning Bolt, the deck aims to control the game tempo and apply pressure on the opponent quickly. The deck also includes counterspells like Force of Will and Stifle to protect its threats and disrupt opposing plays. The mana base of the deck allows for flexibility in casting spells and includes cards like Polluted Delta and Wasteland for mana fixing and disruption.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly and efficiently cheat powerful creatures into play using cards like Show and Tell and Sneak Attack. By using these cards, along with powerful spells like Emrakul, the Aeons Torn and Atraxa, Grand Unifier, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with massive threats early in the game. The deck also includes various ways to protect its combos, such as Force of Will and Veil of Summer, while also including card draw and manipulation through Brainstorm and Ponder. Overall, the deck aims to win the game through its powerful combo interactions.

The main idea of this deck is to utilize the combo potential of Nadu, Winged Wisdom, along with Nomads en-Kor and Delighted Halfling to create a powerful engine that can generate card advantage and potentially win the game in a single turn. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Force of Will and Teferi, Time Raveler to protect the combo and control the game. With efficient card draw and search effects like Brainstorm and Green Sun's Zenith, this deck aims to quickly assemble its combo pieces and outmaneuver the opponent.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly fill the graveyard with powerful creatures using cards like Entomb and Thoughtseize, then bring them back onto the battlefield with Reanimate and Animate Dead. The deck utilizes cards like Brainstorm and Ponder to dig for combo pieces and disrupt the opponent's strategy. It also includes disruptive elements like Force of Will and Daze to protect its game plan. The deck aims to quickly overwhelm the opponent with reanimated threats like Archon of Cruelty and Murktide Regent, while controlling the board with cards like Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student.

The deck focuses on using lands and control elements to disrupt the opponent while setting up a powerful win condition with Dark Depths and Thespian's Stage combo. It aims to control the pace of the game by utilizing cards like Wasteland, Boseiju, Who Endures, Maze of Ith, and The Tabernacle at Pendrell Vale. Life from the Loam and Crop Rotation provide consistency in finding key lands, while cards like Mox Diamond and Exploration accelerate mana production. Overall, the deck aims to outvalue and outmaneuver the opponent through land manipulation and control elements.

This deck focuses on utilizing Nadu, Winged Wisdom as the key combo piece, along with Nomads en-Kor and Stock Up to draw through the deck quickly and create a large board presence. The deck also includes cards like Force of Will and Teferi, Time Raveler for disruption and protection. The use of Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion allows for additional value and flexibility in the deck's strategy. Overall, the deck aims to combo off quickly and overwhelm the opponent with its card advantage and synergy.

The deck focuses on quickly getting out powerful creatures like Griselbrand and Emrakul, the Aeons Torn by utilizing cards like Show and Tell and Sneak Attack. It also includes various ways to protect these creatures and disrupt the opponent's game plan, with cards like Force of Will and Flusterstorm. The deck aims to create explosive turns where it can cheat out huge threats onto the battlefield, overwhelming the opponent and quickly closing out the game before they have a chance to respond. The key strategy is to use these powerful creatures to secure a quick victory.

The deck focuses on controlling the opponent's plays through counterspells and removal spells while utilizing Stoneforge Mystic to bring in powerful equipment like Batterskull and Kaldra Compleat. It also includes cards like Jace, the Mind Sculptor and Teferi, Time Raveler to provide card advantage and disruption. The inclusion of cards like Prismatic Ending, Swords to Plowshares, and Back to Basics helps to deal with a variety of threats. The deck aims to outvalue and outlast the opponent through efficient removal, card advantage, and powerful threats.

Utilizing a combination of disruptive spells and efficient creatures, this deck aims to control the tempo of the game while applying pressure to the opponent. By utilizing cards like Thoughtseize, Force of Will, and Daze to disrupt the opponent's game plan, and combining them with aggressive creatures like Brazen Borrower, Murktide Regent, and Nethergoyf, the deck aims to quickly close out the game before the opponent can stabilize. Additionally, the mana base is optimized for consistency and to support the deck's aggressive game plan.

This UWx Control deck focuses on disruption, removal, and card advantage to control the game and outvalue opponents. It utilizes versatile spells like Swords to Plowshares and Force of Will alongside powerful planeswalkers like Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student to maintain board control. The inclusion of cards like Back to Basics and Magus of the Moon also hampers opponents' mana bases, further delaying their game plan. By balancing removal, countermagic, and card draw, this deck aims to outlast opponents and secure victory through attrition.

This deck focuses on utilizing creature abilities and spellcasting to create a powerful combo with Nadu, Winged Wisdom as the centerpiece. The deck includes various ways to protect and accelerate Nadu's abilities, such as Aphetto Alchemist and Aether Channeler. Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student helps with card draw and manipulation while Force of Will provides necessary control. The deck also includes tools for tutoring and mana generation to consistently set up the combo. Overall, the key concept of this deck is to efficiently set up and execute combos revolving around Nadu's abilities.

The deck focuses on utilizing the combo potential of Nadu, Winged Wisdom and Nomads en-Kor to generate card advantage and overwhelm the opponent. The deck also includes various utility cards such as Force of Will and Swords to Plowshares to control the board and protect the combo pieces. The mana base is designed to support the combo while also providing access to various colors for flexibility. Overall, the deck aims to quickly assemble its combo pieces and disrupt the opponent's game plan to secure a victory.

This Mardu Aggro deck focuses on quickly overwhelming opponents with aggressive creatures and disrupting their game plan with hand disruption and removal spells. The key strategy is to control the board through efficient removal and disruption, while aggressively attacking with creatures to bring the opponent's life total down as quickly as possible. Additionally, the deck utilizes synergies between creatures and planeswalkers to generate value and maintain pressure on the opponent. Land destruction also plays a role in disrupting the opponent's mana base and slowing down their plans.

The main focus of this UR Tempo deck is to control the board and disrupt the opponent's game plan while applying constant pressure with efficient threats. By utilizing a mix of disruptive spells like Force of Will, Daze, and Wasteland, along with powerful tempo plays like Dragon's Rage Channeler and Murktide Regent, the deck aims to quickly close out games. Mishra's Bauble and Preordain provide card selection and consistency, while Lightning Bolt and Brazen Borrower offer versatile removal options. Overall, the deck excels at maintaining a fast-paced, aggressive strategy while disrupting opponent's strategies.

The main concept of this deck is to disrupt the opponent's game plan while applying pressure with efficient creatures and spells. By utilizing cards like Thoughtseize, Daze, and Force of Will to disrupt the opponent's strategy, the deck aims to control the game tempo. At the same time, cards like Nethergoyf, Brazen Borrower, and Murktide Regent are used to quickly close out the game. The deck also includes cards like Brainstorm and Ponder to ensure consistency in drawing the necessary resources. Overall, the deck aims to be aggressive while maintaining control over the game.

This deck focuses on quickly deploying threats and disrupting the opponent using cheap and efficient spells like Lightning Bolt, Daze, and Force of Will. It aims to control the board early on and apply pressure with creatures like Dragon's Rage Channeler and Murktide Regent. The deck utilizes cards like Brainstorm and Ponder to dig for key pieces while also having access to powerful lands like Wasteland to disrupt the opponent's mana base. Overall, the deck's strategy is to force the opponent on the back foot while maintaining a proactive game plan.
